conditions.title: Poisson noise
conditions.description: Add noise whose size grows with brightness.

conditions.title: Half exposure
conditions.description: Make every pixel half as bright.

conditions.title: Higher exposure
conditions.description: Make every pixel 1.5 times as bright.

conditions.title: Dead pixels
conditions.description: Set 10% of pixel positions to zero in all RGB channels.
conditions.formula: y′ = y(1 − M), exactly 10% of positions masked

conditions.title: Fixed-pattern noise
conditions.description: Give each pixel a small gain and offset.

conditions.title: Gaussian blur
conditions.description: Mix nearby pixels with a small blur filter.
conditions.formula: y′ = Gσ * y, σ = 0.5 pixels, filter = 5 × 5

conditions.title: JPEG compression
conditions.description: Compress and decode once at quality 50.
